content:
The incumbents kept their seats in the small cities of Webb County.

In El Cenizo, Mayor Carina Hernandez won re-election with 60.34% of the vote, defeating challenger Juany A. Gomez, who took 39.66%, according to unofficial final results released by the Webb County Elections Office and reported by KGNS on November 4.

In Rio Bravo, Mayor Amanda Perez Aguerro won re-election unopposed, taking 100% of the vote, according to the same results.

According to the Laredo Morning Times, the incumbents in both cities held onto their mayoral seats in the November 3 election.

El Cenizo voters also decided a crowded city commissioner race. Juany Valdez led the field with 25% of the vote, followed by Daisy Perez with 19.82% and Jaime Espinoza with 18.78%. Raul Mata took 16.82%, Humberto Duarte Jr. 12.33%, and Monica Lee Botello Olvera 7.26%.

In Rio Bravo, Adriana Villarreal won the City Council Place 1 seat with 67.84% of the vote over Ismael Rincon's 32.16%, and Yanely Picasso won the Place 2 seat with 74.52% over Nora Rivera's 25.48%.

The results released by the elections office are unofficial final results.

Sources: KGNS, reporting on the Webb County Elections Office unofficial final results for El Cenizo and Rio Bravo on November 4, 2026; Laredo Morning Times.

title: El Cenizo, Rio Bravo incumbents keep their mayoral seats
